title: THE ROOT CAUSE
paragraphs: HSB students struggle to access services and resolve issues because communication, requests, and feedback are fragmented and lack transparency — causing delays, uncertainty, and eroded trust.
Not a Wi-Fi problem.  Not a marks problem.  A visibility problem.
content:
THE ROOT CAUSE
Master Problem Statement
HSB students struggle to access services and resolve issues because communication, requests, and feedback are fragmented and lack transparency — causing delays, uncertainty, and eroded trust.
Not a Wi-Fi problem.  Not a marks problem.  A visibility problem.

title: THE SOLUTION
paragraphs: One platform. One login. Every service request — Wi-Fi, Hostel, IT, Library, Cafeteria — in one place.
Across every ideation theme, the same idea kept resurfacing — a shared layer for raising, routing, and tracking issues.
Screened for Desirability, Feasibility, and Viability — the only concept to score High on all three.

title: HOW IT WORKS
paragraphs: Raise a ticket in seconds — text or Voice-Assisted, in English or Hindi.
Track it against a live SLA countdown — no more wondering who's handling it.
Resolve with a named owner and a notification — not silence.
Feedback & Ideas loop closes visibly: “you said, we did,” not a suggestion box that disappears.
